DIAGNOSIS READY: L5-S1 Herniated Disc.

The MRI confirms a disc herniation at L5-S1 impinging on the nerve root, which explains your sudden onset pain while exercising and radiation down to your foot. Given your age and the acute nature of the injury, have you noticed any loss of sensation in the saddle area or difficulty controlling your bladder or bowels?
